rules: When src-tauri/ changes, also run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

When a fix: squash commit changes app code (src/lib, src/routes, src-tauri/src, src-tauri/build.rs) and the Issue's diff stages nothing under src/tests/, src-tauri/tests/ or e2e/specs/ and adds no #[test]/#[tokio::test]/#[cfg(test)] line, add a 'Test-Exempt: <reason>' trailer saying why no test covers it; the commit-msg hook rejects the commit otherwise (docs/COMMITS.md)
